notes: Gut is the new ceiling. 80g/h carbs works for 4h; watch tolerance after 4-5h.
Cadence is the bonk tell: cruise 75-80; if it drops to 70, back off 5-10W.
Outdoor bike pacing by HR + RPE (no power meter outdoors).
1:50 swim and 6:00 bike targets retired after wrist fracture.

result.conditions: Rain and wind most of the day, poor road surface
result.cause: Course sabotage (metal shards, hundreds of flats) plus a loose TT bar and a wrist not fully healed. Not fitness, fueling, or pacing.
notes: Swim beat target despite a month without swim training (cast). HR 130 avg, controlled.
Bike HR ran high early (over 160 the first 30min) from cold rain and excitement, then settled to 132 in the race band.
TT bars worked loose around km 10, then the course was sabotaged with metal shards.
Stopped at km 120 by choice rather than ride a second lap through the shard zone on tubed tires (crew out of spare tubes). Tubeless riders could continue.
Forward: switch to a tubeless setup, not giving up on future races.
